_readme: Known symbols for ES1's GO.EXE (ES1GO): confirmed address -> meaning mappings, applied to the ES1Recon Ghidra project by ES2ApplySymbolNames.java.
Addresses are offsets into the flat X-32 image (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/x32-executable.md#the-image).
Schema, confidence rules and run order: tools/ghidra_scripts/README.md, 'Known symbols'.
Entries are in address order. tools/scripts/es2_naming.py insert and edit keep it, and check that it holds.

entries.name: X32_AllocMemory
entries.description: (size), C convention: ES1DBSIM's X32_AllocMemory (000001d7), its high-water mark at 0007d554 and EDX stored at 0007d550. Rounds size up to a multiple of 0x1000 and asks the extender for it (INT 21h AX=350Ch); returns the block's address, or -1 on carry.

entries.name: __x386_coproc_init
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `__x386_coproc_init`, from `x386.asm`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. The match covers 86 bytes from here.

entries.name: ClassItem_RegisterBucket
entries.description: (count, entries) in stack order, callee-cleaned: when count is nonzero, appends {entries, count} to the bucket list at 000aa114 (8 bytes per bucket, entries first) and increments its count 0007d788. Light_ResetSystem (000641ec) registers g_TSObjectTypeRegistry with it; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_RegisterBucket (0005513c) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_LoadResource
entries.description: (mode, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: loads one class item. Points the frame pointer 0009a2c8 at a frame on its stack, reads the 8-byte type tag with 00000c92, and for a tag other than -1 looks its handler up with 00000a30 and calls the handler's load function (+4) with (mode, stream); then runs ClassItem_SkipToEnd (00000ea8) on the stream, restores the frame pointer and returns the item, or 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_LoadResource (000551e0) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_StoreItem
entries.description: (item, mode, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes one class item. Points the current-frame pointer 0009a2c8 at a frame on its stack and restores it on exit. When the item's body length (vtable +8) is 0 and the stream's slot +0x10 answers query 3 with 0, it makes a stream over the stream on its stack (0004f08c(local, 0, 0, stream)), opens the item in it (00000bfb) with the item's tag (vtable +4), calls the item's write slot (+0x14) with (mode, that stream), closes the item (00000dc4) and destroys the stream (0004f128, flags 2); otherwise it runs the same open, write and close on the stream itself; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_StoreItem (00055248) in different code.

entries.name: Arena_Alloc
entries.description: (arena, size) in stack order, callee-cleaned: bump-allocates from an arena {base +0, limit +4, cursor +8}: when arena is non-null and cursor + size is at most the limit it returns base + cursor and advances the cursor by size; otherwise it returns operator_new(size); the same statements as ES1DBSIM's Arena_Alloc (000552f8) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_PeekTypeTag
entries.description: (tag, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: saves the stream position (slot +8), reads the 8-byte type tag into tag (-1, 0 beforehand) through the read slot (+0x1c) and, when no handler is registered for it (through the thunk to 00000a30) and 0007d78c is set, copies it to 000aa204, reads the rest of the header (0007d790 less 8 bytes) into 000aa20c and calls 00000a91 through its thunk; seeks back (slot +0xc) unless the status (+0) is 2; returns status == 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_PeekTypeTag (0005533c) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_Skip
entries.description: (stream), callee-cleaned: reads a class item's 8-byte type tag and seeks past its body, the tag's second dword rounded up to an even length; returns status == 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_Skip (000553e4) in different code.

entries.name: ArenaStack_Push
entries.description: (cursor, limit, base) in stack order, callee-cleaned: increments the depth 0007d794, stores {base, limit, cursor} in the 12-byte entry at 0009a2cc + depth * 12, points the current arena 000aa110 at it and returns base; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ArenaStack_Push (00055424) in different code.

entries.name: ArenaStack_Pop
entries.description: No arguments: decrements the depth 0007d794 and points the current arena 000aa110 at the entry below, or at null when the depth has gone negative (a signed test); the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ArenaStack_Pop (000554bc) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_ItemTotalSize
entries.description: (item), callee-cleaned: builds {tag = vtable +4, length = vtable +8} on its stack and returns 00000b00 of it, or 0 when the length is 0; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_ItemTotalSize (00055610) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_DebugPrintType
entries.description: (item, indent, unused) in stack order, callee-cleaned: prints indent spaces and 'Class type: %d:%d' with the high and low words of the item's tag (vtable +4) to stdout, then ' "%s"' with the name in the handler entry 00000a30 finds for the tag, when it finds one, and a newline; the same statements as ES1DBSIM's ClassItem_DebugPrintType (00055648) in different code.

entries.name: ClassItem_SkipToEnd
entries.description: (stream), callee-cleaned: while the stream status (+0) is 0 and its position (slot +8) is below the end of the current class item (the frame 0009a2c8, +8), reads one byte (slot +0x1c); ClassItem_LoadResource (000006ce) runs it after an item's load function, so bytes the load left unread, an Old GLBitmap's whole body among them, are passed over.

entries.name: Heap_Ctor
entries.description: (this), callee-cleaned: the heap object's constructor. With a null this it allocates 0x10 bytes through operator_new and returns 0 if that fails. Stores the address 000aa24a at 000aa24a. Returns the global heap 0009a308 untouched; any other heap gets its four dwords zeroed.

entries.name: Heap_Init
entries.description: (heap, block, size), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Init without the low mark: +0 base, +4 the size as given, +8 the free list (the block, its link zeroed), +0xc and the block's own size the size rounded down to a multiple of 8, and FBLK at the block's +8.

entries.name: Heap_IsAllocated
entries.description: (heap, payload): 1 when the payload lies from the heap's base to its end (+0 + +4) and its header (payload - 8) holds ABLK, else 0.

entries.name: Heap_IsBlock
entries.description: (heap, block header): ES1DBSIM's Heap_IsBlock. 1 when the address lies from the heap's base to 0x10 bytes before its end and carries FBLK at +8 or ABLK at +0, else 0.

entries.name: Heap_IsValidAllocation
entries.description: (heap, payload): 0 unless Heap_IsAllocated. Then 1 when the block's end (header + size) equals the heap's base plus 8 times the dword at +4, which Heap_Init sets to the size in bytes; otherwise Heap_IsBlock on the block's own header.

entries.name: Heap_LargestFree
entries.description: (heap): the largest size on the free list less the 8-byte header. Reads the list's head without testing it for null.

entries.name: Heap_Alloc
entries.description: (heap, size), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Alloc without the trackLow argument and the low mark. First fit on (size + 8) rounded up to 8: an exact block is unlinked, one more than 0x10 bytes larger is split with the tail left free (FBLK); tags the block ABLK, zero-fills the payload, takes the size off +0xc and returns the payload. 0 for size 0 or when nothing fits.

entries.name: Heap_Free
entries.description: (heap, payload), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Free. Nothing for null; otherwise adds the size back to +0xc, tags the block FBLK, inserts it into the free list in address order and merges it with touching free neighbours.

entries.name: Heap_Realloc
entries.description: (heap, size, payload), callee-cleaned: ES1DBSIM's Heap_Realloc with its branches inverted and returning early, and without the low mark. Size 0 frees; a smaller size gives the tail to a following free block, frees it as its own block when over 0x10 bytes, or moves the data; a larger size takes it from a following free block that has room, or moves the data. Calls Heap_IsBlock, Heap_FindPrevFree, Heap_Alloc, Heap_Free and memmove.

entries.name: Heap_DrawMap
entries.description: (heap, rows, columns, top, left), callee-cleaned (RET 0x14): divides the heap's +4 size into rows x columns equal shares and walks the global heap 0009a308's blocks with HeapIter_Init and HeapIter_Next, working out for each cell the share of its bytes in ABLK blocks. Each cell is passed to Mono_Printf (0004f904) with left + column, top + row, 0007d7b0 and a character by that share: 7 for none, 0xb1 below 50%, 0xb2 below 100% and 0xdb for all.

entries.name: Heap_FindPrevFree
entries.description: (heap, block): ES1DBSIM's Heap_FindPrevFree. The free block whose link is the given block; 0 when it heads the list or the walk ends.

entries.name: HeapIter_Init
entries.description: (this, heap), callee-cleaned: a two-dword heap walker. With a null this it allocates 8 bytes through operator_new and returns 0 if that fails. Stores the heap at +0 and the heap's base, its first block, at +4.

entries.name: HeapIter_Next
entries.description: (walker), callee-cleaned: returns 0 when the walker's block (+4) is 0. Otherwise steps +4 on by the block's size, sets it to 0 when that reaches the heap's base plus size, and returns the new +4.

entries.name: Mem_InitHeap
entries.description: (size): ES1DBSIM's Mem_InitHeap with the cap at X32_LargestFreeBlock() - 15000: takes the block from X32_AllocMemory, asserting 'Memory alloc failed' (src\memory.cpp line 494, severity 5) through Assert_Report when that returns -1, makes it the heap 0009a308 (Heap_Init) and sets 0007d7b4.

entries.name: Mem_HeapOff
entries.description: Clears 0007d7b4, after which operator new and malloc take memory from X32_AllocMemory and the frees do nothing.

entries.name: operator_new
entries.description: The program's operator new (size), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Alloc(0009a308, size) while 0007d7b4 is set, otherwise X32_AllocMemory(size) with -1 returned as 0.

entries.name: Mem_AllocFromHeap
entries.description: (heap, size), callee-cleaned (RET 8): Heap_Alloc(heap, size) on the heap it is given.

entries.name: operator_delete
entries.description: The program's operator delete (pointer), callee-cleaned (RET 4): Heap_Free(0009a308, pointer) while 0007d7b4 is set, otherwise nothing.

entries.name: malloc
entries.description: The program's malloc (size), C convention: operator_new's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: free
entries.description: The program's free (pointer), C convention: operator_delete's body, returning with a plain RET.

entries.name: realloc
entries.description: The program's realloc (pointer, size), C convention: Heap_Realloc(0009a308, size, pointer), whether or not 0007d7b4 is set.

entries.name: calloc
entries.description: The program's calloc (count, size), C convention: ES1DBSIM's calloc over the heap 0009a308 and flag 0007d7b4. Clears the block over the size in the header before it, which a block from X32_AllocMemory does not have.

entries.name: Mem_ConstructHeap
entries.description: No arguments, C convention: Heap_Ctor(0009a308), the global heap.

entries.name: Raster_DrawLine
entries.description: (from, to), C convention: draws a line between two {x, y} points with the pen at the installed clip block's +0x224 (the block 0008441c points at): mode 0 a flat colour, mode 2 a span remap through g_RasterRoutines slot 1 (000865b4), a colour whose top byte is 4 read from the colour ramps at 00085da9. The points move by the block's translation when +0x208 is set. Clip mode 0 draws the whole line and mode 1 the line clipped to the rect at +0x20c (0004ffac): a flat colour through slot 34 (00086638), a remap as the spans 0004fe60 scan-converts it to. Other modes take each region of the list at +0: a rect region clips the line with 0004ffac, a span region intersects the line's spans with it through 0004fc50, and each piece goes to the pen's span routine. The code of ES1DBSIM's Raster_DrawLine (0006a064), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: Tech_LoadFile
entries.description: (state, path) in stack order, callee-cleaned: opens path as a VolRStream, reads it into state with Tech_Read (00001e16), closes the stream, and calls Tech_Unlock (00001f78)(state, 0). es2_xref finds two calls, both from CareerRecord_Init (000158ff), with bst\tech_0.dat and bst\tech_sng.dat.

entries.name: Tech_Read
entries.description: (state, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: reads an int16 count, then for each record an int16 kind and an int16 index, and for kind 0 reads 4 bytes (two int16 mission counts) into state + 4 + 5 * index, for kind 1 into state + 0x2c + 5 * index; a record of any other kind is read and dropped, and the index is not bounds-tested. The 8-byte records of bst\tech_0.dat and bst\tech_sng.dat.

entries.name: Tech_Clear
entries.description: (state), callee-cleaned: zeroes the unlocked byte of each of the 8 chassis entries (state + 8 + 5 * i) and of each of the 17 weapon entries (state + 0x30 + 5 * i). It leaves the mission counts and the words at +0 and +2 as they were.

entries.name: Tech_WriteWeaponFlags
entries.description: (state, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes the unlocked byte of each of the 17 weapon entries (state + 0x30 + 5 * i), one byte each, through the stream's write slot +0x18. es2_xref finds one call, from CareerRecord_WriteWeaponFlags (000160ac).

entries.name: Tech_Unlock
entries.description: (state, missions) in stack order, callee-cleaned: copies entry 0x2d of the text table 0009afa8 (eng\watext.bin, NONE) into 0007d7e0 through sprintf %s. The grade test passes, except when the mode word 000aad56 is 1 and missions is not 0, where it passes when Mission_OutcomeGrade (00036837)(000aad58, 000aad5e) is below 2. Each of the 8 chassis entries (state + 4 + 5 * i: int16 first, int16 second, byte unlocked) that is locked and holds no -1 unlocks when first <= missions with the grade test passing, or second <= missions; each of the 17 weapon entries (state + 0x2c) the same with == for <=. Unlocking sets the byte, copies the item's name (table 0009afa8 entry 0x1b + i for a chassis, 0xd5 + i for a weapon) into 0007d7e0, and stores the kind (0, 1) at state +0 and the index at +2. es2_xref finds two calls: Tech_LoadFile (00001dd4) with 0, and Shell_ProcessMissionResults (00038eb5) with the career record's missions played.

entries.name: Tech_FormatLockedName
entries.description: (state, index, kind) in stack order, callee-cleaned: when kind is 0 and chassis entry index is locked (byte state + 8 + 5 * index is 0), copies entry 0x1b + index of the text table 0009afa8 into 0007d808 through sprintf %s; when kind is 1 and weapon entry index is locked (state + 0x30), entry 0xd5 + index. es2_xref finds no branch to it and no stored pointer.

entries.name: Alert_LoadBnd
entries.description: No arguments: Ovl_ReadFile(bnd\alert, 1, 6, 0009a318) in stack order, the whole of BND\ALERT.BND. The static initialiser 00003c22 registers it at phase 1 with RegisterSubsystemLoader (0000fca0).

entries.name: Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts
entries.description: No arguments: WidgetStyles_Load (00044aa4)(dat\styles); then dfn\title, cpylw, active, pushed, inactive, nm_green and nm_red1 each through 0004b757, its result to the dwords 000aacc6 to 000aacde, four bytes apart; then dba\corners through 0004b7df into 000ab4ee. ES1DBSIM's Widget_LoadStylesAndFonts (00045e10) with the last two fonts green6x8 and red6x8. Caller found by es2_xref: 00012ec7, which then loads CFG\styles.dat with WidgetStyles_Load and res32\corners.dba with 0004b7df.

entries.name: CtlAlert_LoadBnd
entries.description: No arguments: Ovl_ReadFile(bnd\ctl_alrt, 1, 0x86, 0009a34c) in stack order, the whole of BND\CTL_ALRT.BND. The static initialiser 00006ebe registers it at phase 1 with RegisterSubsystemLoader (0000fca0).

entries.name: CalAlert_LoadBnd
entries.description: No arguments: Ovl_ReadFile(bnd\cal_alrt, 1, 0x46, 0009a3d4) in stack order, the whole of BND\CAL_ALRT.BND. The static initialiser 0000816a registers it at phase 1 with RegisterSubsystemLoader (0000fca0).

entries.name: Map_LoadBnd
entries.description: No arguments: Ovl_ReadFile(bnd\map, 1, 0x20, 0009a420) in stack order, the whole of BND\MAP.BND. The static initialiser 00009174 registers it at phase 1 with RegisterSubsystemLoader (0000fca0).

entries.name: ShellMap_LoadBnd
entries.description: No arguments: Ovl_ReadFile(bnd\shellmap, 1, 0x8e, 0009a44c) in stack order, the whole of BND\SHELLMAP.BND. The static initialiser 0000dcbd registers it at phase 1 with RegisterSubsystemLoader (0000fca0).

entries.name: ShellMap_LoadResource
entries.description: (path), callee-cleaned: opens path with VolRStream_CtorFromPath, loads one class item from it with ClassItem_LoadResource in mode 0, closes the stream and returns the item. es2_xref finds three calls, two from 000093b3 (dba\icons, dba\mapshp) and one from ShellMap_LoadZoneShapes (0000c7e3, dba\tex1).

entries.name: ShellMap_LoadShapeRoots
entries.description: (tag, path, out) in stack order, callee-cleaned, src\shellmap.cpp: ES1DBSIM's Shape_LoadAllRoots (000635a8) without its skip. Opens path with VolRStream_CtorFromPath, pushes an arena with cursor 0, the limit the dword at 0009a4d6 and the base the pointer at 0007e20c (ArenaStack_Push), then for each chunk ClassItem_PeekTypeTag finds: a tag other than tag is a severity-5 assert (line 0x61); ClassItem_LoadResource in mode 0 into a 100-slot stack buffer, the loop not testing the count against it. Copies the pointers into an array from the current arena 000aa110 (Arena_Alloc), stores it through out, ArenaStack_Pop, closes the stream and returns the count in AX. es2_xref finds one call, from ShellMap_LoadZoneShapes (0000c7e3).

entries.name: ShellMap_LoadZoneShapes
entries.description: (map, theater, zone) in stack order, callee-cleaned, src\shellmap.cpp: the map screen's load of a zone's shapes from dat\zone<zone>, the file ES1DBSIM's Terrain_LoadZoneShapes (00020238) reads. For a negative zone it zeroes the map's int16 count +0xc8 and its pointers +0xca and +0xd0 and returns. Otherwise it builds the path by ltoa (radix 10) over the XXXX of a copy of 'zoneXXXX' (0007e378) and ResourcePath_BuildFolderName, opens it (severity-5 assert, line 0x565, when it fails), reads the word at +0 into a local it does not use again and the count into +0xc8. ShellMap_LoadShapeRoots(0x2bc0001, dgs\<name>, map + 0xca), the name ShellMap_TheaterNames (0007e228)[theater], gives the root count, stored at +0xce; ShellMap_LoadResource(dba\tex1) goes to +0x4c3. When the count is not 0 it allocates count pointers at +0xd0 and for each 20-byte record reads a shape index (2 bytes), a position (12) and three angles (6), stores +0x4c3 in the root shape's +0x26, builds TSObj_Ctor(0, roots[index]) and stores the angles at the object's +4, the position at +0x1e and 0 at +0x2a. Neither index is tested against a count, nor the object against null. Closes the zone file. It reads no dat\<name>, and its objects carry no record pointer. es2_xref finds one call, from 0000c068 at 0000c779, which passes header words 0 and 1 of data\script.dat.

entries.name: ShellMap_PlaceSquad
entries.description: (map), callee-cleaned, src\shellmap.cpp: sets the squad size +0xc6 from the word 0007ebc8; opens dat\mforms (severity-5 assert, line 0x59e, when the stream status is set), reads the count into a local and then formation + 1 records of 0x1c bytes into one buffer, the formation being +0x9e; heading: +0xa4, when not negative, indexes the int16 table +0x58, else with a path +0x6a of two points or more 000553bc of its first leg less 0x4000, else 0, made a rotation by Math_BuildRotation2D; anchor: point +0xa2 of the 12-byte points +0x52, or the path's first point when +0xa2 is -1. Each of the eight member refs at +0xa8 that is not -1 and is below +0xc6 gets the anchor at +0xd4 + 12 * k, plus for k above 0 the record's int16 slot k with z 0 turned by 000552e0. The second half of VSHELL's ShellMap_ReadSquadHeader (00424db0), without its player.mec read. Caller found by es2_xref: 0000c068.

entries.name: MechFormation_SlotCtor
entries.description: (slot), callee-cleaned: allocates 4 bytes when slot is null and returns it, storing nothing; ShellMap_PlaceSquad (0000cab1), which reads dat\mforms, runs it with __vec_ctor over a formation's seven 4-byte slots. The code of ES1DBSIM's MechFormation_SlotCtor (00019a14), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: TSObj_Ctor
entries.description: (object, shape) in stack order, callee-cleaned: TS_OBJ's constructor (the image holds the class names DRAWABLE, MAT_OBJ and TS_OBJ just before the vtables 0007e428, 0007e512 and 0007e536), allocating 0x32 bytes when object is null and returning null when that fails. Installs DRAWABLE's vtable 0007e428 at +0, zeroes the orientation block at +4 (its three int16 Euler angles at +0, its translation at +0x1a and its word +0x26), installs MAT_OBJ's 0007e512 and then TS_OBJ's 0007e536 at +0, stores TSShapeInstance_Ctor(0, shape) at +0x2c (0 for a null shape), clears the byte at +0x30 and returns the object. ES1DBSIM's TSObj_Ctor (00001b04) builds a 0x3b-byte object with DRAWABLE's vtable at +2, the block at +6, the shape instance at +0x2e and 8 bytes cleared at +0x32. es2_xref finds one call, from ShellMap_LoadZoneShapes (0000c7e3).

entries.name: RegisterSubsystemLoader
entries.description: (phase, function) in stack order, callee-cleaned: stores function and the int16 phase in the next 6-byte record at 000aa2c4, the record index being the int16 count at 0007e5c8, which it increments; Subsystem_RunPhase (0000fcda) walks the records. es2_xref finds eight calls, from the static initialisers of the eight bnd\ loaders, each at phase 1. ES1DBSIM's RegisterSubsystemLoader (00000ac4).
entries.source: ES1GO decompile at 0000fca0, against ES1DBSIM's RegisterSubsystemLoader

entries.name: Subsystem_RunPhase
entries.description: (phase), callee-cleaned: calls, in order, each function of the 6-byte {function, int16 phase} records at 000aa2c4 (count int16 0007e5c8) whose phase matches. One call found by es2_xref, from Shell_Main (00012ec7) with phase 1. ES1DBSIM's Subsystem_RunPhase (00000af4).
entries.source: ES1GO decompile at 0000fcda, against ES1DBSIM's Subsystem_RunPhase

entries.name: CtlMgr_LoadBnd
entries.description: No arguments: Ovl_ReadFile(bnd\ctl_mgr, 1, 6, 0009adec) in stack order, the whole of BND\CTL_MGR.BND. The static initialiser 00010dce registers it at phase 1 with RegisterSubsystemLoader (0000fca0).

entries.name: Main_LoadBnd
entries.description: No arguments: Ovl_ReadFile(bnd\main, 1, 0x14, 0009ae18) in stack order, the whole of BND\MAIN.BND; Shell_Main (00012ec7) reads its dwords +8 and +0xc. The static initialiser 000131cb registers it at phase 1 with RegisterSubsystemLoader (0000fca0).

entries.name: Shell_Main
entries.description: (a, b), src\main.cpp: the shell's main; es2_xref finds one call, from 0000000d. Mem_InitHeap(the dword 0007e738, 3700000), asserting at severity 5 (line 0x1f8) when it gives 100000 bytes or fewer; 0001272d(b, a), and when that returns non-zero Mem_HeapOff and __exit(1); copies to 000aae06, for 0000035e, the ALT_DRIVE variable (taken as null unless 0007fd0b is set) when PREFER_ALT is set and the string at 0007e942 otherwise; 0001289c, 0001280a, 00012be3; VolumeGroup_SetBufferSize(0x200), VolRStream_SetGroup(PREFER_ALT set, ALT_DRIVE, 0007e943, 0x100), Subsystem_RunPhase (0000fcda)(1), which reads the eight bnd\ files; an assert at severity 5 (line 0x219, the shortfall printed with sprintf) when the heap is under the dword 0009ae24, BND\MAIN.BND's +0xc, and the byte 0007fd09 set when it is under 0009ae20, the file's +8. Then unnamed set-up calls, among them WidgetStyles_Load (00044aa4)('CFG\styles.dat') and 0004b7df('res32\corners.dba') into 000ab4ee, and Palette_UploadWhole(0007fcd0); a loop until the byte 0007fd05 is set, which 000817c0 = 9999 also sets; after it, shut-down calls, VolRStream_DeleteGroup and Mem_HeapOff, and INT 3 when 0007fd08 is set. ES1DBSIM's Sim_Main (00059350) opens with Mem_InitHeap(6000000) and the same assert.

entries.name: BattleSet_Dtor
entries.description: (set, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: returns when set is null; frees the campaign array +2 (__vec_delete, 8-byte elements, with Campaign_Dtor (00014355)) and zeroes it; calls PilotNames_Free (00015153); deletes set when bit 0 of flags is set.

entries.name: BattleSet_Load
entries.description: (set, index) in stack order, callee-cleaned: loads the string table bst\batlsets.bin into a stack table (TextTable_Ctor (0001865c), Text_LoadDataFile through a VolRStream), reads the battle set file its entry index names into set with BattleSet_ReadFile (00013fad), then calls SingleMissions_Load (000361ac) and PilotNames_Load (00015070), and destroys the stream and the table.

entries.name: BattleSet_FreeCampaigns
entries.description: (set), callee-cleaned: when the campaign array +2 is set, frees it (__vec_delete, 8-byte elements, with Campaign_Dtor (00014355)) and zeroes it.

entries.name: BattleSet_ReadFile
entries.description: (set, name) in stack order, callee-cleaned: BattleSet_FreeCampaigns (00013f7a); opens bst\<name> (sprintf, VolRStream_CtorFromPath); reads one byte into the low byte of the campaign count +0; when nonzero, makes that many 8-byte campaigns at +2 (__vec_new with Campaign_Ctor (00014075)), reads each with Campaign_Read (0001422c) and sets campaign i's word +0 to word i of the table at 0007ea94 (0, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3); destroys the stream.

entries.name: Campaign_Ctor
entries.description: (campaign), callee-cleaned: allocates 8 bytes when campaign is null (returning 0 when that fails); zeroes the position count word +2 and the position array +4; returns it.

entries.name: BattleSet_GetMissionName
entries.description: (set, outcome, position, campaign) in stack order, callee-cleaned: takes Campaign_GetPositionName (000142f6)(campaign's record, outcome, position); returns it when Str_FindBoyerMoore finds .MSN in it. entries.name: Campaign_GetPositionName
entries.description: (campaign, outcome, position) in stack order, callee-cleaned: StrList_Get (00020254)(the 6-byte position record position of the array +4, outcome).

entries.name: Campaign_NextPosition
entries.description: (campaign, position*) in stack order, callee-cleaned: adds 1 to *position; returns 1 when it is at least 0 and below the position count +2, else 0.

entries.name: Campaign_Dtor

entries.name: Screenshot_BuildPath

entries.name: PilotNames_Load
entries.description: (), C convention: reads car\names.dat through a VolRStream: a count byte of groups into a new pointer array at 0007ebc4, then per group a count byte and a new pointer array of that many 16-byte buffers, each filled by Stream_ReadCString (00020154) with a bound of 16. es2_xref finds one call, from BattleSet_Load (00013f01).

entries.description: (), C convention: frees 12 groups of 3 names from the array at 0007ebc4, then each group's array and the array, and zeroes 0007ebc4. The counts are constants, not the file's. es2_xref finds one call, from BattleSet_Dtor (00013eac).

entries.name: CareerRecord_Init
entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: zeroes bytes +0 and +1 and the words +2, +6, +8, +0xa, +0xe and +0x12, sets +4 to 0x6a4 and the word 000aad58 to 0, zeroes the 100 words at +0x12d (CareerRecord_ClearWords (000161ae)), clears the equipment state at +0xa8 (Tech_Clear (00001ee3)) and loads it with Tech_LoadFile (00001dd4) from bst\tech_0.dat when the mode word 000aad56 is 1 and bst\tech_sng.dat otherwise, then sets the state's words +0 and +2 (record +0xa8, +0xaa) to -1. It sets the pilot count +0x10 to 4 and for each 0x25-byte pilot entry from +0x14 calls 000151c8 when the mode is 0 or the entry is the one +0xe names, and 00015228 otherwise. es2_xref finds two calls: 000163ac with a roster record (roster + 0x23 + 0x1f7 * i), and MsnGen_LoadMission (00035873) with 0009b014.

entries.description: (outcome), callee-cleaned: 1 when outcome is greater than the word of the table at Career_OutcomeThresholds (0007ec80) (4, 4, 4, 3, 3, 3, 4, 3, 3, 3) that the word 000aad5e indexes, else 0.

entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: BattleSet_GetMissionName (000140a5)(g_BattleSet (000a02cc), Career_OutcomeChoice (000159e9)(word 000aad58), the record's position word +8, its campaign word +6); formats the name as msn\%s into 000aad14; Mission_SetTextPath.

entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: BattleSet_Advance (000141d0)(g_BattleSet (000a02cc), Career_OutcomeChoice (000159e9)(word 000aad58), the record's position +8, its campaign +6); returns whether the campaign word changed.

entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: returns BattleSet_PeekNextCampaign (0001418e)(g_BattleSet (000a02cc), Career_OutcomeChoice (000159e9)(word 000aad58), the record's position word +8, its campaign word +6); the decompile drops the return value, which EAX carries from the call.

entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: bubble-sorts a stack copy of the three pilot entry indexes at 0007ec9c (1, 2, 3) by each entry's word +0xd (record + 0x14 + 0x25 * i + 0xd), greatest first, swapping with Word_Swap (00015c93); then for each place p of the three sets the entry's byte +0xa (record + 0x1e + 0x25 * i) to 1 when p + 1 is below the word 0007ebc8, and to 0 otherwise. es2_xref finds one call, from Career_StartMission (00016e93).

entries.description: (record, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Tech_WriteWeaponFlags (00001f2b)(record + 0xa8, stream). es2_xref finds one call, from 00022a05.

entries.name: CareerRecord_ClearWords
entries.description: (record), callee-cleaned: zeroes the 100 int16 at +0x12d. es2_xref finds two calls, from CareerRecord_Init (000158ff) and 00016f22.

entries.name: Roster_NthUsedRecord
entries.description: (roster, n) in stack order, callee-cleaned: returns 0 when n is 0; otherwise counts the records 1 to 0x28 (roster + 0x23 + 0x1f7 * i) whose first byte is not 0 and returns the index of the n-th, or 0 when there are fewer. Career_StartMission (00016e93) stores the result in the roster's word +7; es2_xref finds seven calls to Career_StartMission, each passing the roster 0009b218 and 0.

entries.name: Career_StartMission
entries.description: (roster, b) in stack order, callee-cleaned: sets the roster's word +7 to Roster_NthUsedRecord (00016845)(roster, b); BattleSet_Load (00013f01)(g_BattleSet (000a02cc), the roster's word +5); Career_BuildMissionPath (00015a13) on the 0x1f7-byte record at roster + 0x23 + 0x1f7 * word +7; MsnGen_LoadMission (000aad14); CareerRecord_MarkTopPilots (00015cbb)(the record); copies the word 000aad5a to the record's +0xc; Mission_WriteRestore.

entries.name: TextTable_Ctor
entries.description: (table), callee-cleaned: allocates 16 bytes when table is null (returning 0 when that fails); zeroes the offsets +0, the pool +4 and the count +8.

entries.name: TextTable_CtorFromStream
entries.description: (table, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: allocates 0x10 bytes when table is 0, zeroes +8, +0 and +4, and reads the table from the stream with Text_LoadDataFile (00018755).

entries.name: TextTable_Dtor
entries.description: (table, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: when table is non-null, deletes its offset array (+0) and pool (+4), and the table itself when bit 0 of flags is set.

entries.name: Text_GetString
entries.description: (table, index) in stack order, callee-cleaned: formats "Text::getString: Index out of bounds" with the index into a stack buffer that nothing reads, then returns the table's string base (+4) plus the uint16 at index in its offset array (+0); there is no bounds test. MsnGen_LoadMission (00035873) takes data\script.dat, data\mission.var and car\sm_play.mec from entries 3, 5 and 10 of the table at 0009afb8, which FileNames_Load (0002094d) loads from cfg\filename.bin through Text_LoadDataFile (00018755).

entries.name: Text_LoadDataFile
entries.description: (table, stream) in stack order, callee-cleaned: reads the int32 count into +8 and the int32 pool size into +0xc, allocates count * 2 bytes at +0 and the pool size at +4 with operator_new, reads the offsets and the pool into them through the stream's read slot (+0x1c), and returns 1 when the stream status (+0) is 0, else 0. VSHELL's Text_LoadDataFile (0040828a), without its assert on a stream error.

entries.name: Mission_WriteObjectives
entries.description: (path): opens path through VolRStream_CtorFromPath and finds its first OBJ: block with Stream_FindNthTag (0004b6d6); with none it closes the stream and returns. Otherwise it reads the int32 byte count, the int16 sum of lengths and the int16 piece count, then per piece a byte it does not test, an int16 length and that many bytes; removes data\object.str (file-name entry 6) and writes it through a FileRWStream (severity-5 assert at dialog.cpp line 0x56): an int32 written as 9999 and then set to the bytes after it, the int16 count, and per piece its int16 length, its text and a 0 byte.

entries.name: Dialog_LoadFromFile
entries.description: (dialog, a, b, path), callee-cleaned: deletes the dialog's box and stream as Dialog_LoadConditional (00018cdb) does, opens path through VolRStream_CtorFromPath, reads the version word into +4; version 0 builds a DefaultDialogBox (DefaultDialogBox_Ctor (00019149)) at +6, version 2 a DigitalDialogBox (DigitalDialogBox_Ctor (00019279), passed a and b); closes the stream. es2_xref finds one call, in DigitalDialog_ShowMessage (00037edd), which passes an eng\*_text.bin path.

entries.name: Dialog_LoadConditional
entries.description: (dialog, ordinal, tag, path), callee-cleaned: deletes the dialog's box (Dialog_DeleteBox (00018d93)) and its stream at +0, opens path through VolRStream_CtorFromPath into +0, reads the version word into +4, and when it is 1 builds the box at +6 with ConditionalDialogBox_Ctor (00019453) from the tag's block of that ordinal, otherwise sets +6 to 0; closes the stream with VolRStream_Close. The loader of a mission's .ENG blocks.

entries.name: Dialog_DeleteBox
entries.description: (dialog): when the dialog's box at +6 is set, calls its destructor (vtable +0x29, slot +4) with 3 and sets +6 to 0.

entries.name: Dialog_PrevPage
entries.description: (dialog): when the dialog has a box at +6, steps it back a page with DialogBox_PrevPage (000190fd) and calls 00018dcb(dialog).

entries.name: Dialog_NextPage
entries.description: (dialog): when the dialog has a box at +6, steps it forward a page with DialogBox_NextPage (0001911f) and calls 00018dcb(dialog).

entries.name: ConditionalDialogBox_SetRect
entries.description: (box), callee-cleaned: rounds the word 000817c4 down to a thousand and looks it up in the four ints at 0007ee44 (6000, 5000, 3000, 4000) with a jump table beside them: 6000 copies the 16 bytes at 0009ae84 to +5 and sets +0 to 0; 5000 the bytes at 0009ae94 and +0 to 0 (code at 00018ea6 Ghidra left undefined); 3000, 4000 and any other value the bytes at 0009ae64 and +0 to 1.

entries.name: DialogBox_PrevPage
entries.description: (box): when the page +0x27 is above 0, decrements it and clears the byte +0.

entries.name: DialogBox_NextPage
entries.description: (box): when the page +0x27 is below the page count +0x23 less 1, increments it and clears the byte +0.

entries.name: DefaultDialogBox_Ctor
entries.description: (this): allocates 0x2d bytes when this is 0; DialogBox_Init (00019b25); vtable 0007eea8; font 000aacda; the 16 bytes at 0009ae64 as the box; sprintfs 'This is a Default Dialog Box.' into a new buffer at +0x15; DialogBox_Layout (000198a6).

entries.name: DefaultDialogBox_Dtor
entries.description: (this, flags): slot +4 of vtable 0007eea8; stores the vtable, calls 00019b54(this, 0) and deletes this when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: DigitalDialogBox_Ctor
entries.description: (this, a, b, dialog): allocates 0x2d bytes when this is 0; DialogBox_Init (00019b25); vtable 0007ef04; builds a text table from the dialog's stream with TextTable_CtorFromStream (00018695); font 000aacda; DigitalDialogBox_SetRect (000193ee)(box); copies the table's string of index word 000aad5c (Text_GetString) into a new buffer at +0x15; DialogBox_Layout (000198a6); passes a and b to maybe_SncList_PlayEntry (000453be)(0009afd4, a, b); frees the table with TextTable_Dtor (000186db)(table, 2).

entries.name: DigitalDialogBox_Dtor
entries.description: (this, flags): slot +4 of vtable 0007ef04; stores the vtable, calls maybe_SncList_Stop (00045556)(0009afd4) and 00019b54(this, 0), and deletes this when flags bit 0 is set.

entries.name: DigitalDialogBox_SetRect
entries.description: (box), callee-cleaned: rounds the word 000817c4 down to a thousand and looks it up in the four ints at 0007ef10 (3000, 5000, 4000, 7000) with the jump table beside them: 3000, 5000 and 4000 copy the 16 bytes at 0009ae64 to +5 and set +0 to 1; 7000 copies those at 0009aea4 and sets +0 to 0 (code at 00019435 Ghidra left undefined); any other value changes nothing. ConditionalDialogBox_SetRect (00018e5f) is the same shape over other boxes.

entries.name: ConditionalDialogBox_Ctor
entries.description: (this, ordinal, tag, dialog), callee-cleaned: allocates 0x2d bytes when this is 0; DialogBox_Init (00019b25); vtable 0007ef48 at +0x29; font 000aacda at +1; ConditionalDialogBox_SetRect (00018e5f). Finds the tag's block of that ordinal in the dialog's stream with Stream_FindNthTag (0004b6d6); reads the int32 byte count and the int16 sum, which it does not use; a count of 0 leaves +0x15 and +0x1b 0. Otherwise allocates the count's bytes as the text (+0x15) and reads pieces until the byte 0x10: 1, an int16 length and that many bytes read over the previous piece's NUL; 2, a flag index whose value MissionVar_ReadFlag (0003628d) gives, a count n, n offsets into a ten-word stack array, n - 1 (low, high) pairs of which the last holding the value inclusively picks a text, and one more pair it does not test; it then reads the picked text at the position after the pairs plus its offset and seeks to that position plus the last offset. Any other byte is passed over. Lays the text out with DialogBox_Layout (000198a6).

entries.name: DialogBox_Layout
entries.description: (box): line height = 00051ff0(font, text) - 2; the slot count +0x19 = HudFont_MeasureString(font, text) / (right - left) + 2; lines per page +0x25 = (bottom - top) / line height; page count +0x23 = slots / lines per page, plus 1 when they differ; page +0x27 = 0; allocates and zeroes the slot pointers +0x1b, and with __vec_new one 8-byte point per line of a page at +0x1f, line i at (left, top + (i + 1) line heights); then calls 00019a1d(box, right - left, text).

entries.name: DialogBox_Init
entries.description: (box): sets the byte +0 to 1 and zeroes the font +1, the text +0x15, the line slots +0x1b, the line points +0x1f and the words +0x19, +0x23, +0x25 and +0x27.

entries.name: Stream_ReadCString
entries.description: (stream, max, buf) in stack order, callee-cleaned: reads one byte at a time through the stream's slot +0x1c into buf until it has read a NUL or max bytes; returns the count of bytes before the NUL, or max.

entries.name: StrList_Read

entries.name: StrList_Get
entries.description: (list, index) in stack order, callee-cleaned: the first name when the count +0 is 1, else name index of the pointer array +2, with no bounds test.

entries.name: StrList_PickRandom
entries.description: (list), callee-cleaned: the name Math_RandomBelow(0009aec0, the count +0) indexes in the pointer array +2.

entries.description: (list, flags) in stack order, callee-cleaned: returns when list is null; when the pointer array +2 is set, deletes each of the count +0 names and the array and zeroes +2; deletes list when bit 0 of flags is set.

entries.name: FileNames_Load
entries.description: (), C convention: loads cfg\filename.bin through a VolRStream into the text table at 0009afb8 with Text_LoadDataFile (00018755), and closes and destroys the stream. Entries 3, 5, 7 and 10 are data\script.dat, data\mission.var, data\results.dat and car\sm_play.mec. es2_xref finds one call, from Shell_Main (00012ec7).

entries.description: (this): the war map screen (vtable 00080bc6, class name WarMapMenu before it), built over the Menu base (vtable 00080ba8) with 0x26 bytes allocated when this is 0. Loads the briefing, block 0 of BRF: from the .eng path 000aad2a, into the dialog 0009afc8 with Dialog_LoadConditional (00018cdb) and calls Dialog_NextPage (00018e18) as many times as the word 000809b2; sets 000809a8 to 3; when the byte 0007fd08 is 0 calls 00027bbf and, with its result, 00025d19, 00025ce6(r, 0x20000) and 0001ffdc(0005d6a0, 000809ac); sets 000aa778 to 1.

Loads the DEB: block of ordinal word 000aad58 from the .eng path 000aad2a into the dialog 0009afc8 with Dialog_LoadConditional (00018cdb).

VSHELL's Msn_ResolveRow6Ref (00415b44) less its flag: ES1's always skips the records whose GUID is -1, so the parser's repeat test gets that count rather than the record's slot.

entries.name: Msn_ResolveRow9Ref
entries.description: (count, guid) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Msn_ResolveRow6Ref (000313f1) over the trigger area records (00080f44, 12 bytes each). VSHELL's Msn_ResolveRow9Ref (00415c79) less its flag.

entries.description: (count, guid) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Msn_ResolveRow6Ref (000313f1) over the action records (00080f48, 30 bytes each). VSHELL's Msn_ResolveRow10Ref (00415ce0) less its flag.

entries.name: Msn_ResolveRow16Ref
entries.description: (count, guid) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Msn_ResolveRow6Ref (000313f1) over the group records (00080f3c, 88 bytes each). VSHELL's Msn_ResolveRow16Ref (00415db6) less its flag.

VSHELL's Msn_ResolveRow12Ref (00415e1d).

entries.description: (skipUnnamed, count, guid) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Msn_ResolveRow12Ref (00031711) over the flyer records (00080f34, 64 bytes each). VSHELL's Msn_ResolveRow13Ref (00415e87).

entries.description: (skipUnnamed, count, guid) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Msn_ResolveRow12Ref (00031711) over the base records (00080f40, 24 bytes each). VSHELL's Msn_ResolveRow14Ref (00415eed).

entries.description: (key), callee-cleaned: for each condition record (00080f24, 00080f4e of them) of type 3 whose +6 is key, draws Math_RandomBelow (00038774) on the generator 0009aec0 below its +0xa into its +0xc and returns the index of the first type-2 record whose parent (+2) is its GUID and whose unsigned range +6..+8 holds the draw; with none it goes on to the next such type-3 record, and returns -1 after the last. entries.description: (count, key) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Msn_VariantSourceRow6 (000319fc) over the flyer records. VSHELL's Msn_VariantSourceRow13 (00416276).

entries.name: fclose
entries.description: The runtime's fclose (stream), C convention: -1 for a null stream. For one open in any mode (flags +0xc & 0x83) it flushes it with fflush unless flag 4 (unbuffered) is set, and closes the handle +0x10; when the stream's temporary-file number at 000ab57e[(stream - _iob) / 0x18] is set it removes the file named by that number in decimal (ltoa, remove) and clears it; then File_FreeBuffer and a memset of the FILE's 0x18 bytes. entries.name: fwrite
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `fwrite`, from `fread.c`: (buffer, size, count, stream), C convention: writes size * count bytes and returns the number of whole items written. A stream with flag 0x100 (+0xc) takes them one fputc at a time; a buffered one (flag 4 clear) copies them into its buffer (pointer +0, room +4) with memmove, calling 0006544d with the byte when the room is 0; an unbuffered one in write mode (flags & 0x32 == 2, a read-write stream with 0x80 switched to it first) takes one write to its handle (+0x10), setting the error flag 0x20 on a short count, and otherwise writes nothing. The code of ES1DBSIM's fwrite (000604ac), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: fread
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `fread`, from `fread.c`: (buffer, size, count, stream), C convention: reads up to size * count bytes and returns the number of whole items read. A stream with flag 0x100 (+0xc) gives them one fgetc at a time; a buffered one (flag 4 clear) copies them out of its buffer (pointer +0, count +4) with memmove, refilling it through 0006557e when it is empty; an unbuffered one in read mode (flags & 0x31 == 1, a read-write stream with 0x80 switched to it first) calls 00065344 and takes one read from its handle (+0x10), setting the end-of-file flag 0x10 when it returns 0 and the error flag 0x20 when it fails. entries.description: LZHuffman constructor, callee-cleaned (this): allocates 0x16 bytes through operator_new when this is null (0 if that fails), then through operator_new the frequency table +4 (0x4e8 bytes), the parent links +8 (0x75a) and the child links +0xc (0x4e6), LZHUF's sizes for 314 symbols and a 627-node tree. The class stores no vptr. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_Ctor (00082734), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_Dtor
entries.description: LZHuffman destructor (this, flags): returns at once for a null this; otherwise operator_delete on the tables +4, +8 and +0xc, and on this when bit 0 of the flags is set. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_Dtor (0008277c), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_Start
entries.description: (coder, source): attaches the source at +0, clears the bit-input state +0x10..+0x15, and builds LZHUF's initial tree: 314 (0x13a) leaves of frequency 1 (frequencies +4) whose child links (+0xc) are 0x273 + i and parent links (+8, from +0x4e6) their node, then the internal nodes 0x13a..0x272 each summing a pair, the sentinel frequency 0xffff at node 0x273 and parent 0 for the root 0x272. LZHUF's StartHuff. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_Start (000827b8), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodeChar
entries.description: (coder, c): walks the parent links (+8, leaf c's at +0x4e6) up to the root 0x272, shifting each node's low bit into the code from the top, then LZHuffman_PutCode(coder, code, bit count) and LZHuffman_Update(coder, c). LZHUF's EncodeChar. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_EncodeChar (000828d0), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodePosition
entries.description: (coder, position): LZHuffman_PutCode with the code 00094304[position >> 6] << 8 and the length 000942c4[position >> 6] (LZHUF's p_code and p_len), then the low six bits << 10 in 6 bits. LZHUF's EncodePosition. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_EncodePosition (00082940), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_DecodeChar
entries.description: (coder): walks the child links (+0xc) from the root (+0x4e4) one LZHuffman_GetBit at a time until a leaf (>= 0x273), LZHuffman_Update's it and returns leaf - 0x273. LZHUF's DecodeChar. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_DecodeChar (00082984), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_DecodePosition
entries.description: (coder): reads a byte with LZHuffman_GetByte, takes the upper six bits from 00094344 and the bit count from 00094444 (LZHUF's d_code and d_len), shifts count - 2 more bits from LZHuffman_GetBit into the byte from below and returns its low six bits | upper << 6, a 12-bit position. LZHUF's DecodePosition. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_DecodePosition (000829e8), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_EncodeEnd
entries.description: (coder): writes the top byte of the bit buffer (+0x13) when bits are pending (+0x15), then a zero byte, each through the stream's slot +0x18. LZHUF's EncodeEnd with a trailing 0. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_EncodeEnd (00082a44), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_GetBit
entries.description: (coder): while the bit count +0x12 is below 9, reads a byte through the source's slot +0x1c (0 when the read fails), ORs it into the 16-bit buffer +0x10 below the bits held and adds 8 to the count; then shifts out and returns the top bit. LZHUF's GetBit. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_GetBit (00082a90), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_GetByte
entries.description: (coder): LZHuffman_GetBit's refill, then shifts out and returns the top 8 bits. LZHUF's GetByte. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_GetByte (00082b08), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_PutCode
entries.description: (coder, code, length) in stack order: ORs the code, shifted right by the pending bit count +0x15, into the output buffer +0x13 and adds length to the count; at 8 bits or more writes the buffer's top byte through the stream's slot +0x18, and when 8 still remain its low byte too and keeps code << (length - count). LZHUF's Putcode. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_PutCode (00082b80), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_Reconstruct
entries.description: (coder): rebuilds the adaptive Huffman tree: gathers the leaves (child link above 0x272) to the front with their frequencies (+4) halved, rounding up, rebuilds the internal nodes 0x13a..0x272 in frequency order with memmove, and relinks the parents (+8). LZHUF's reconst. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_Reconstruct (00082c20), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: LZHuffman_Update
entries.description: (coder, c): LZHuffman_Reconstruct when the root frequency (+4 at 0x4e4) is 0x8000, then increments the frequencies from leaf c up to the root, swapping a node past its lower-frequency successors to keep the order, with their child and parent links. LZHUF's update. The code of ES1DBSIM's LZHuffman_Update (00082e10), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: VGA8_BlitBitmapClipped
entries.description: (header, point, clip, flags), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's clipped blit, its table's +0x70: with clip non-null trims the bitmap's columns and rows to the rect clip (returning when nothing is left), picks the start and the row and column steps by flags bits 1 and 2, and draws each destination row with VGA8_BlitClippedRow, a plane at a time. With header byte +5's bit 4 set every byte is written; with it clear a 0 byte is skipped (OR AL,AL / JZ at 0007495f in VGA8_BlitClippedRow). The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_BlitBitmapClipped (0008c27c), relocated operands aside.
entries.source: ES1GO decompile at 00074650; es2_naming.py diff against the ES1DBSIM twin

entries.name: VGA8_BlitClippedRow
entries.description: A block of VGA8_BlitBitmapClipped, near-called with its frame (EBP) per destination row ([EBP-0x38]): in clip mode +0x204 2 clips the row to each region of the clip block's list in turn, a type-0 rect or a type-2 span region, passing over regions of other types; otherwise draws it once. For each of the four planes writes that plane's pixels of the row, every byte when header bit 4 is set, and only the non-zero ones when it is clear. The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_BlitClippedRow (0008c41a), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon
entries.description: (count, points), C convention: the VGA_8 driver's table +0x84, which Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch calls for brush modes 5 and 7. Reads the brush at the clip block's (0008441c) +0x228: +8 the int32 {u, v} texture points, +0xc the bitmap header, +0x10 the colour table only for mode 7 (0 otherwise). Nothing for fewer than 3 points, a polygon with no height or no width, or one wholly outside the clip rect +0x20c..+0x218; one whose smallest y is above the rect's top is cut there with VGA8_BitmapPolyClipTop into two 32-point buffers on its own stack and redone. Walks by columns when the clip mode +0x204 is not 2 (edges from the first leftmost vertex, A forward and B backward, VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupColumns/StepColumns, x in 000ab7b0, VGA8_SpanBitmapColumn per column from the rect's left) and by rows when it is 2 (from the first topmost vertex, A backward and B forward, the Rows pair, y in 000ab7ac, VGA8_SpanBitmapRow from the rect's top); stops when either edge ends at the far vertex, past the rect's far side, or when A's other coordinate exceeds B's, so the far vertex's column or row is never drawn. ES1DBSIM's VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon (000534ac), but that the two clip buffers are locals built with __vec_ctor on every call where ES1DBSIM's are statics built on first use.
entries.source: ES1GO decompile at 00074fcc; es2_naming.py diff against the ES1DBSIM twin

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapPolyPointCtor
entries.description: (p), callee-cleaned: the empty constructor of an 8-byte int32 point, allocating 8 bytes when p is null; VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon's element constructor for the two 32-point clip buffers on its stack. The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_BitmapPolyPointCtor (00053864), relocated operands aside.
entries.source: ES1GO decompile at 00075418; es2_naming.py diff against the ES1DBSIM twin

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapPolyClipTop
entries.description: (top, texOut, pointsOut, countOut, texIn, pointsIn, countIn) in stack order, callee-cleaned: cuts a polygon and its texture points at y = top, keeping y >= top. Walking the ring from vertex 0, emits each vertex with y >= top and, when the edge to the next vertex crosses, the crossing c = c_i + (top - y_i) * (c_n - c_i) / (y_n - y_i) for each of x, u and v, from the vertex the edge leaves, the division truncating; the new count goes to countOut. The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_BitmapPolyClipTop (00053880), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapEdgeStepRows
entries.description: (edge), callee-cleaned: steps a row-walk edge of VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon one row: decrements +4 and at 0 starts the next edge from vertex +8 with VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupRows, returning 0 when that fails; otherwise adds +0x14 to u +0xc, +0x18 to v +0x10, +0x20 to x +0x1c, +0x2c to the error +0x28 and, when the error is positive, +0x24 (+-1) to x and subtracts +0x30. Returns 1. The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_BitmapEdgeStepRows (000539e4), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapEdgeStepColumns
entries.description: (edge), callee-cleaned: VGA8_BitmapEdgeStepRows for a column-walk edge, starting the next edge with VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupColumns; +0x1c is then the edge's y. The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_BitmapEdgeStepColumns (00053a3c), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupRows
entries.description: (vertex, edge), callee-cleaned: starts a row-walk edge of VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon from vertex: steps the index by the edge's +0 (+-1, wrapping round the count 000aa0f0) past vertices with the same y, and returns 0 on reaching the far vertex 000aa0ec. Otherwise stores the row count dy at +4, the next vertex at +8, u and v (texture point << 16) at +0xc/+0x10 and their steps Math_Q16Divide(du << 16, dy << 16) at +0x14/+0x18, x at +0x1c, its whole step dx / dy at +0x20, the +-1 carry at +0x24, the error at +0x28 (0, or 1 - dy for a leftward edge), the remainder |dx| % dy at +0x2c and dy at +0x30, so step k's x is x0 + ceil(k * dx / dy); returns 1. The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupRows (00053a94), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupColumns
entries.description: (vertex, edge), callee-cleaned: VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupRows with x and y exchanged: the count is the vertices' x difference, +0x1c the edge's y and its steps from the y difference. The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_BitmapEdgeSetupColumns (00053c18), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: BMP8_BlitBitmap
entries.description: The BMP_8 driver's bitmap blit, its table's (0008b380) +0x68: copies the bitmap's rows into the canvas bitmap, by flag bits 1 and 2 in one of four orders. With header byte +5's bit 4 set each row is copied whole, or byte by byte when mirrored; with it clear each 0 byte is skipped, leaving the destination. es2_xref.py finds three calls from 000769f8. The same statements as ES1DBSIM's BMP8_BlitBitmap (0008d700) in different code.
entries.source: ES1GO decompile at 000764bc; es2_naming diff against ES1DBSIM 0008d700, labels only

entries.name: Emu8000_WriteWord
entries.description: (value, register) in stack order, callee-cleaned: writes a word to a Sound Blaster AWE32 EMU8000 register with interrupts off (restored only when they were on). The register code's bits 0-4 (channel) and bits 12-14 (moved to bits 5-7) go to the pointer port, the Data0 port 000993fa + 0x802; the value goes to Data0 + (code & 0xc00), plus 2 when bit 9 is set. 00077316 sets Data0 to the base it is given, adding 0x400 to one below 0x300 (0x220 becomes 0x620). The code of ES1DBSIM's Emu8000_WriteWord (00085133), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: Emu8000_ReadWord
entries.description: (register), callee-cleaned: Emu8000_WriteWord's port selection, reading the word with IN instead. The code of ES1DBSIM's Emu8000_ReadWord (000851a0), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: Emu8000_WriteDword
entries.description: (value, register) in stack order, callee-cleaned: Emu8000_WriteWord for a 32-bit register: the low word to the selected data port and the high word to that port + 2. The code of ES1DBSIM's Emu8000_WriteDword (00085210), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: Emu8000_ReadDword
entries.description: (register), callee-cleaned: Emu8000_ReadWord for a 32-bit register: the low word from the selected data port, the high word from that port + 2. The code of ES1DBSIM's Emu8000_ReadDword (00085291), relocated operands aside.

entries.name: VGA8_SpanBitmapRow
entries.description: (edgeA, edgeB, header, table), C convention: one row (000ab7ac) of VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon from edgeA's x +0x1c to edgeB's, both included, n pixels. du = Math_Q16Divide(uB - uA, n << 16), dv likewise; pixel i samples u = uA + (du >> 1) + i * du, v likewise, texel at header +0xa + round(v) * header +2 + round(u) (the 0x8000 add carried into the unsigned high words), stepped exactly in 16.16. Clip mode +0x204 other than 2 clamps to the rect +0x20c..+0x214 columns (skipped pixels advancing u, v by Math_Q16Multiply); mode 2 walks the clip block's region list from the last entry, drawing the row's part in every type-0 rect (+4..+0x10) or type-2 span region holding it, and returns at any other type. Writes the planar display through the sequencer's map mask, ROL-stepping the plane. With table 0 a texel of 0 is not written (OR AH,AH / JZ at 0007bd2e); otherwise every texel is written as table[texel]. The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_SpanBitmapRow (000735a4), relocated operands aside.
entries.source: ES1GO decompile at 0007b9c8; es2_naming.py diff against the ES1DBSIM twin

entries.name: VGA8_SpanBitmapColumn
entries.description: (edgeA, edgeB, header, table), C convention: one column (000ab7b0) of VGA8_FillBitmapPolygon from edgeA's y +0x1c to edgeB's, both included: VGA8_SpanBitmapRow's sampling, clamped to the clip rect's rows +0x210..+0x218 in every clip mode, writing one plane 80 bytes a pixel. With table 0 a texel of 0 is not written (OR AH,AH / JZ at 0007bf6b); otherwise every texel is written as table[texel]. The code of ES1DBSIM's VGA8_SpanBitmapColumn (0007394a), relocated operands aside.
entries.source: ES1GO decompile at 0007bd6e; es2_naming.py diff against the ES1DBSIM twin

entries.description: Byte: when set, Raster_SetModelTransform moves each registered light into the model's space and the save and restore carry the lights' copies. ES2's DBSIM 006cbc88. ES1DBSIM's Light_ModelSpaceEnabled is at 000bdbce.
